name: resistance band cable squat
description: A squat against band tension that builds the quads and glutes while the band pulls you forward, so your core has to work too.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles at your chest, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand up.
